name: Hiring Signals Intelligence
description: CLI-first tool, built for AI agents, that surfaces genuine, matching IT job postings as soon as they appear publicly across multiple ATS providers
author: Teycir Ben Soltane
search: Workers AI (@cf/baai/bge-base-en-v1.5) + Vectorize -- write path (embed-at-ingest) and query-side hybrid search both live on GET /api/v1/signals

architecture.apps/cli: CLI, primary interface -> planned, not started (decided with the user 2026-08-07); JSON-by-default, no interactive prompts, thin client over apps/api
architecture.apps/api: Cloudflare Worker API: routes, cron scheduler, queue consumer, daily reconciliation job, semantic-search service, CSV export route (Hono)
architecture.packages/domain: Zod schemas, taxonomies, classification, lifecycle, signal scoring (v2), embedding-text, search-merge
architecture.packages/adapters: AtsAdapter interface; 8 active ATS adapters (greenhouse, lever, ashby, recruitee, breezy, personio, smartrecruiters, workable)
architecture.packages/test-support: Live Cloudflare bindings & transport layer for zero-mocks testing
architecture.infrastructure: D1 migrations (0001-0004) + ops scripts (add-source, update-source, add-company, source-health, backfill-embeddings, import-sources)

status.phase: Milestones A-F, H, L, M, and I.1-I.4 complete
status.phaseDescription: CLI-first: apps/web deleted 2026-08-07 (decided with the user), primary interface is now apps/cli (planned, not started -- see ROADMAP.md Milestone F.1). 8 active ATS adapters live. CSV export and bulk onboarding complete. Ingestion, scoring, reconciliation running end-to-end. Full task-by-task detail in ROADMAP.md.
completed: pnpm workspace setup, strict TypeScript base config, Prettier, shared ESLint base

Next.js 16 Minimal Brutalist dashboard UI (apps/web): /signals feed with FilterRail, SignalCard list, cursor pagination, loading/error/empty states, URL searchParams sync -- shipped, then apps/web was deleted 2026-08-07 (CLI-first decision); this entry records completed work, the code no longer exists
Signal Detail view (/signals/[signalId]): shipped inside apps/web, removed with it 2026-08-07 -- see prior entry
Hono Worker with full middleware chain, real cron scheduler, real queue consumer, daily reconciliation cron
role taxonomy, ATS provider enum, NormalizedJob/Signal/IngestMessage Zod schemas
full D1 schema with indexes, migrations 0001-0004
parameterized D1 client wrapper; read repos (signals/companies/facets/export) and write repos (sources/jobs/signals/companies)
API routes querying D1 for real: GET /api/v1/signals, /signals/:id, /companies, /companies/:slug, /facets, /sources, /export/signals.csv
CSV Export endpoint (GET /api/v1/export/signals.csv) with RFC-4180 streaming serializer, 2,000-row safety limit, and truncation header
8 active P0 ATS adapters: Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Recruitee, Breezy, Personio, SmartRecruiters, Workable
full ingestion pipeline: fetch -> validate -> normalize -> upsert -> observe -> lifecycle -> classify -> score -> signal, idempotent per (sourceId, runId)
real Volume/Acceleration/Breadth signal scoring (score_version v2) and all four company-level signal types (hiring_burst, role_acceleration, multi_location, persistent_demand)
daily reconciliation job recomputing stale active signals' scores without altering last_detected_at
description-channel classification-noise fix (Milestone H.1)
reopened role lifecycle refinement with 3-day absence threshold (daysSinceLastSeen >= 3)
security hardening: safeRateLimitIdentifier() SHA-256 base64url hashing (rate-limit.ts) and trusted-first IP extraction (client-ip.ts)
Vectorize index (hiring-signals-jobs, 768-dim, cosine) + Workers AI binding provisioned; jobs embedded and upserted at ingest time, best-effort/non-blocking
query-side semantic-search service and merge logic implemented and wired live into GET /api/v1/signals (apps/api/src/services/semantic-search.ts, packages/domain/src/signal-search-merge.ts)
search UI (search bar, recent-searches, more-like-this): shipped inside apps/web (Milestone I.4), removed with it 2026-08-07
bulk source onboarding ops script (infrastructure/scripts/import-sources.mjs)
zero-mocks live test infrastructure (packages/test-support) running against real Cloudflare D1/KV resources
all workspace tests passing workspace-wide (pnpm -r test); pnpm -r typecheck and pnpm -r lint clean across all workspaces
pending: apps/cli (Milestone F.1), the new primary interface -- planned, no code yet
classification assist from embeddings (I.5, explicitly deferred until I.1-I.4 have run in production)
production deployment (Cloudflare Workers API; no UI to deploy)
explicitlyNotPlanned: authentication of any kind -- the app is public/free permanently by deliberate design decision (spec sections 3, 10.5, 11.1), not a gap awaiting Cloudflare Access or similar

features.export: CSV export of filtered signal list (GET /api/v1/export/signals.csv, spec section 10.6, live)
features.ingestion: Cloudflare Worker cron triggers (15-min source scheduler, daily reconciliation) with adaptive cadence per provider

nonGoals: no collection of private profiles or personal data
no bypassing logins, CAPTCHAs, rate limits, robots directives
no general-purpose HTML scraping (official ATS APIs only)
no push notifications, email digests, or webhook alerting
no automated sending of cold email or LinkedIn messages
no claims about confirmed projects, budgets, or purchasing decisions
